selection_basis: Best observed dev NDCG@5 for Russian queries; trained checkpoint selected earlier on combined EN/RU dev. RRF retained as a baseline. Calibration and native CLIP did not establish an improvement.
limitations: Absolute known-positive retrieval quality is low.
Russian queries are machine translations with identified semantic errors; 47 formatting failures were replaced by assistant translations.
Dev bootstrap differences include zero; no claim of statistically established superiority.
Test results must not be used to retune this selection.
